content: Draft 2020-12 strict-schema authoring: additionalProperties:false + required listing every property enforces exact key sets; $defs + $ref for shared subschemas (model card reused across model_performance and task_performance schemas); closed enums via enum:[...] on string fields; anyOf [{type:number},{const:''}] expresses number-or-empty-string for missing-metric convention. Live-verified against all 42 committed files: uniform key sets (info=11 keys, dataset=8, parameters=9, performance=14) — all-strict validates with zero errors.
